note: Machine translated by scripts/translate_content.py; not reviewed by an educator.

letter.title: Letters
letter.ask: Point to each letter. Ask the child to say it.

word.title: Words
word.ask: Ask the child to read each word.

sentence.title: Sentences
sentence.ask: Ask the child to read each sentence aloud.

story.title: Short passage
story.ask: Ask the child to read each line like a story. A line passes if it is smooth, with at most 1 mistake.

num_1_9.title: Numbers 1–9
num_1_9.ask: Point to each number. Ask the child to say it.

num_10_99.title: Numbers 10–99
num_10_99.ask: Point to each number. Ask the child to say it.

add_single.title: Single-digit sums
add_single.ask: Read each sum aloud. The child answers (fingers or objects are fine).

sub_borrow.title: 2-digit subtraction (borrowing)
sub_borrow.ask: Write each sum on the slate. The child solves it.

mult.title: Multiplication
mult.ask: Read each question aloud. The child answers.
